description: Classification overlay for bytes outside the authenticated full/augmented function instruction union. It preserves uncertain bytes as unresolved and keeps exact listing instruction rows in additional_instructions.
policy: Only ranges with kind=data are authenticated defined data and only kind=padding may be emitted as literal fill by the baseline generator.
Potential missed instructions and structured tables remain kind=unresolved; additional analysis may promote them after boundaries are independently validated.
A repeated CC or 00 pattern is recorded as a padding candidate, never as proof of padding.
The overlay covers the exact complement of the initial instruction union: no bytes are silently dropped or assigned twice.
